text: wavespeed-dsh-skill 是一个 DSH 技能插件，为代理提供 WaveSpeed 媒体生成能力。它将打包的技能目录注册到 DSH 的技能系统，复用文件系统技能提供器。主要功能包括根据文字生成图像和视频、编辑或延续图像与视频、调用平台模型生成音频和 3D 内容，以及查看模型输入并估算视频价格。适合希望在 DSH 工作流中创作或处理多种 AI 媒体的用户。使用 CLI 时需要安装 wavespeed 命令行工具并登录 WaveSpeed；也可使用已连接的 WaveSpeed MCP 工具。

wavespeed-dsh-skill adds WaveSpeed media tools to DSH. It supports image and video generation and editing, video continuation, model runs, schema inspection and price estimates. Use the CLI for local files or connected WaveSpeed MCP tools. CLI use requires the CLI and WaveSpeed login.

wavespeed-dsh-skill 的功能「生成图像」：根据文字提示生成图像，也可以附加参考图片。通过 WaveSpeed CLI 的 generate image 命令或已连接的 MCP 工具触发，返回生成结果。
wavespeed-dsh-skill 的功能「生成与延续视频」：根据提示词和首帧、末帧或参考素材生成视频，也可延续已有视频；可先估算价格再提交。
wavespeed-dsh-skill 的功能「编辑媒体」：根据文字指令编辑、重绘或组合图像，也可以编辑视频；通过 CLI 快捷命令或对应 MCP 工具提供输入并获得处理结果。
wavespeed-dsh-skill 的功能「调用平台模型」：通过通用 run 命令选择平台模型并填写参数，可在运行前查看模型输入结构，结果可读取并下载。
wavespeed-dsh-skill 使用前须知：CLI 需安装并登录；MCP 需授权且不能读取本地文件。（见 skills/wavespeed/SKILL.md:10-11,80-84）

wavespeed-dsh-skill README · WaveSpeed skill for DeepSeek Harness：[中文](README.zh.md)

A [DeepSeek Harness](https://github.com/deepseek-ai/deepseek-harness) (dsh) skill that lets the agent generate and edit AI media — image, video, audio, 3D — through the [WaveSpeed](https://wavespeed.ai) platform, using the open-source [`@wavespeed/cli`](https://github.com/WaveSpeedAI/wavespeed-cli).

wavespeed-dsh-skill README · WaveSpeed skill for DeepSeek Harness：For images and videos the skill uses the CLI's shortcuts (`wavespeed generate|edit|extend`, defaults Seedream 5 Pro and Seedance 2.5), and the WaveSpeed MCP tools when they are connected. Every other model on the platform is one `wavespeed run <model-id>` call: the skill teaches the agent to browse the live catalog, read any model's input schema, and execute it — including uploading local files with the `@path` marker.

wavespeed-dsh-skill README · Requirements：- Node.js ≥ 18
- The WaveSpeed CLI: `npm install -g @wavespeed/cli`
- A WaveSpeed account — `wavespeed login` opens the key page at [wavespeed.ai](https://wavespeed.ai) and handles the rest

wavespeed-dsh-skill README · Install：As a dsh plugin (recommended — the bundle registers the skill automatically):

```bash
dsh plugin --profile web add github:WaveSpeedAI/wavespeed-dsh-skill
```

Or copy the skill directory by hand — project-level (checked into the repo,
shared with your team):

```bash
mkdir -p .dsh/skills
git clone --depth 1 https://github.com/WaveSpeedAI/wavespeed-dsh-skill /tmp/wss \
  && cp -r /tmp/wss/skills/wavespeed .dsh/skills/ && rm -rf /tmp/wss
```

User-level (available in every project):

wavespeed-dsh-skill README · Install：```bash
mkdir -p ~/.dsh/skills

```

Other agents (Claude Code, Cursor, Codex): the CLI installs the same skill directly —

```bash
wavespeed skill install
```
